# m.partners.tmx.corporate_events

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Corporate events from TMX: earnings dates, dividends, conferences, and more.

Call it from a session `m`:

```python
m.partners.tmx.corporate_events(symbols=None, *, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

- Query methods: `fetch()`, `poll()`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `TmxRecordId`

[Dataset index](README.md)

A linked argument follows the [shared rules](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | Tickers as TMX writes them; None, the default, for no ticker filter (`dm.ALL` is refused). |
| [`start`](README.md#start) | The first event day. |
| [`end`](README.md#end) | The end of the range. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | Massive's field to sort by, such as `"date"`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Such as `{"type": "earnings"}`. Keys: `isin`, `isin_any_of`, `isin_gt`, `isin_gte`, `isin_lt`, `isin_lte`, `status`, `status_any_of`, `status_gt`, `status_gte`, `status_lt`, `status_lte`, `ticker_gt`, `ticker_gte`, `ticker_lt`, `ticker_lte`, `tmx_company_id`, `tmx_company_id_gt`, `tmx_company_id_gte`, `tmx_company_id_lt`, `tmx_company_id_lte`, `tmx_record_id`, `tmx_record_id_any_of`, `tmx_record_id_gt`, `tmx_record_id_gte`, `tmx_record_id_lt`, `tmx_record_id_lte`, `trading_venue`, `trading_venue_any_of`, `trading_venue_gt`, `trading_venue_gte`, `trading_venue_lt`, `trading_venue_lte`, `type`, `type_any_of`, `type_gt`, `type_gte`, `type_lt`, `type_lte`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Corporate Events (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| TMX Corporate Events | Updated every 2 hours, All history |
| TMX Corporate Events Business | Updated every 2 hours, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `ticker`: "The company's stock symbol." |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. |
| `CompanyName` | String | Full name of the company. |
| `Date` | String | Scheduled date of the corporate event, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `Isin` | String | Standard international identifier for the company's common stock. |
| `Name` | String | Name or title of the event. |
| `Status` | String | The current status of the event. Possible values include: approved, canceled, confirmed, historical, pending_approval, postponed, and unconfirmed. |
| `TmxCompanyId` | String | Unique numeric identifier for the company used by TMX. |
| `TmxRecordId` | String | The unique alphanumeric identifier for the event record used by TMX. |
| `TradingVenue` | String | MIC (Market Identifier Code) of the exchange where the company's stock is listed. |
| `Type` | String | The normalized type of corporate event. Possible values include: analyst_day, business_update, capital_markets_day, conference, dividend, earnings_announcement_date, earnings_conference_call, earnings_results_announcement, forum, interim_statement, other_interim_announcement, production_update, research_and_development_day, seminar, shareholder_meeting, sales_update, stock_split, summit, service_level_update, tradeshow, company_travel, and workshop. |
| `Url` | String | URL linking to the primary public source of the event announcement, if available. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. |
